g.text: rate by 0.005 with a confidence interval that excludes zero, but lowers sentiment macro-F1 by 0.006, also significant. fp10 is a failed intermediate

g.text: Macro-F1 = the plain average of the F1 score for each of the three sentiment classes (negative, neutral, positive), so the rare negative class counts as much as the common

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: neutral one. Word error rate = (words substituted + words dropped + words inserted) / words in the reference transcript; 0.18 means about 18 errors per 100 reference words.
